title: Chapter 739
text:
Eternal Night Star System, Planet Avitan.

This planet was not the home planet of the Star Pupil Protoss but a rather prosperous and important administrative planet. It was considered a first-tier colonial planet of the entire civilization, and its location was excellent. It was similar to a trading port and an important economic center. There were more than twelve billion permanent residents, and a huge number of foreigners were coming in every day.

In a certain main city of Planet Avitan, a floating vehicle shuttled between the skyscrapers. The Star Pupil Protoss, who were born with the ability to fly, followed the flight path of the transportation plan. The city was prosperous and peaceful.

However, on this day, the peace of Planet Avitan was broken.

A black and red meteorite suddenly appeared outside the atmosphere, and the observation radar did not detect the trajectory of this meteorite at all. It was as though it had appeared out of thin air.

The meteorite was falling at an extremely fast speed toward this main city, leaving very little time for the fleet stationed on Planet Avitan to react.

Countless fully automated planetary air defense arrays in the atmosphere quickly reacted, releasing a huge amount of dark energy and forming an outer orbit capture net that stretched for hundreds of miles, blocking the path of the meteorite.

This kind of device was usually used to capture meteorites. The dark energy was almost tangible, and it had extremely strong elasticity, toughness, and ductility. It could use the tens of thousands of meters between the atmosphere and the ground as a buffer zone to cover the meteorite and eliminate its kinetic energy.

However, the meteorite directly pierced through the outer orbit capture net like a knife cutting through silk.

The planetary air defense arrays immediately carried out the second plan, shooting out countless tracking annihilation rays, preparing to intercept the meteorite in the sky and turn it into dust. However, the annihilation rays also failed. The meteorite seemed indestructible, and at the same time, it had some kind of anti-targeting ability, misleading the radar's judgment, and a large number of annihilation rays missed.

Looking up from the ground, one could see a large number of annihilation rays melting the air, forming strange black spots.

Wu wu wu!

At the same time, the entire city where the meteorite was falling sounded an air raid alarm. Countless underground shelter entrances appeared on the surface of the city, and a large number of citizens hid in the underground shelters nearby. The streets quickly became deserted and empty.

At this time, the city also activated a super-large protective shield, protecting the entire city, preparing to withstand the impact of the meteorite's fall. Tens of thousands of anti-aircraft dark energy cannons extended from the ground at the edge of the city. They opened fire and fired in unison toward the sky. It was as if black rain was pouring down from the ground.

Outside the protective shield of the city, the Calamity Grade Star Pupil Protoss who was guarding this city floated in midair.

The black and red meteorite wrapped in dense flames, it rapidly enlarged in his blue eyes.

"The flames are too thick, and I can't see the appearance of this meteorite clearly. It's about to fall, I have to intercept it!"

This Guardian was a Calamity Grade Psychic. He looked up at the meteorite that was falling Meteorite and crazily released his Psychic energy, superimposing it in front of the meteorite, hoping to stop it or make it deviate from its trajectory.

However, he was shocked to find that once his psychokinesis came into contact with the meteorite, it would automatically dissipate. It could not form an obstruction at all.

"What the hell is this thing …"

In the next second, the meteorite suddenly accelerated and crashed through the city's protective shield, landing in the center of the city.

Bang!

A crater hundreds of meters long appeared on the ground. The tornado-like flames quickly dissipated, revealing the full appearance of the 'meteorite'. It was a dark, human-shaped creature that seemed to be made of mist. Black smoke was popping up all over its body. It did not have any facial features. Its face was a swirl with a red spot of light at the center, as if that was its core.

It was EsGod's doppelganger!

The satellites of Planet Avitan were watching from high up in the sky, broadcasting the situation to the other cities on the planet. The actions of EsGod's doppelganger were seen by billions of people.

The garrison of Planet Avitan had already sensed that something was wrong. The city guardian wanted to surround EsGod's doppelganger with the Supers, and the garrison fleet was also on the move. Spaceships that looked like shuttles quickly gathered, and more than half of the armed forces of Planet Avitan were rushing to the city that was being attacked.

However, the next moment, the actions of EsGod's doppelganger caused a global panic.

He opened his arms, and his energy level increased rapidly. The terrifying energy gathered like a supernova that was about to explode!

Hum!

The next moment, the intense light made all the people of Planet Avitan close their eyes. Then, the radiation interference forcefully cut off the satellite's observation.

However, even without the broadcast, the people of Planet Avitan could feel it …

The ground beneath their feet shook!

A black and red energy ball with EsGod's doppelganger as the center expanded rapidly, swallowing the entire city. Looking down from outer space, it looked like a black pimple had grown on the ground.

The energy ball expanded to cover the entire city and seemed to have expanded to its limit.

At this time, the energy ball suddenly separated into two layers of energy. The outer layer of energy decayed, its color becoming lighter, maintaining its original size, while the inner layer began to shrink rapidly. It looked like a large, light black hemisphere covering a small, dark red hemisphere.

When the inner layer shrunk to half of its original size, the entire energy ball seemed to have lost its balance. Be it the inner layer or the outer layer, they all exploded, turning into radioactive explosive energy. The shockwave swept through everything!

Boom!

The earth was wailing, and a huge rift valley was born from this city. Be it the city guards, the ground troops, or all the people in the underground sanctuary, they were all turned into dust in this destructive explosion.

It was like the end of the world!

After who knew how long, the aftermath of the explosion finally ended. This main city was wiped off the map and no longer existed.

All the tall buildings were flattened, and only a huge crater and a huge rift valley were left.

There was not a single person left alive in the entire city.

EsGod's doppelganger slowly flew up from the bottom of the crater, rushing out of the dust and exposing himself to the satellite.

He paused in midair for a while before suddenly flying in a certain direction, which was the location of another city.

The satellite broadcast recovered, and everyone on Planet Avitan saw this scene. Everyone seemed to have forgotten how to breathe.

Endless panic gripped everyone's heart.

Just a few minutes after the 'big explosion', every news channel of the Star Pupil Protoss immediately broadcast emergency news, broadcasting what had happened on Planet Avitan to the entire civilization.

…

At the same time, a fleet surrounded Sisko's spaceship and set off from the mother planet of the Star Pupil Protoss to reinforce Planet Avitan.

Three 'Light Fox' spaceships that maintained stealth mode were quietly floating not far away from the mother planet of the Star Pupil Protoss.

"Sisko is on the move. The first step is a success!"

Colin revealed a ferocious smile and clenched his fists in excitement.

Sisko guarded the mother planet all year round, and the Evolution Cube was stored on the mother planet. Only by luring Sisko away would they have a chance to steal the Evolution Cube.

Sisko's weakness was that he valued his race. As long as he placed a Beyond Grade A EsGod doppelganger on an important colonial planet and massacred the Star Pupil Protoss, Sisko would definitely leave the mother planet to reinforce them. This was an open scheme to lure the tiger away from the mountain.

Unless Sisko did not care about the lives of the people on that planet, he had no other choice.

EsGod had given his first doppelganger an extremely destructive Esper Ability.

EsGod could create countless doppelgangers, but it was not without limitations. Although he had countless Esper Abilities, his doppelgangers could not use all of them. Only when his main body gave his Esper Abilities to his doppelganger would the doppelganger have these abilities. His main body could not use the Esper Abilities he had given to his doppelganger until the doppelganger was destroyed or removed.

For example, if he gave ten Esper Abilities to his doppelganger, these ten Esper Abilities would be temporarily frozen and could not be used by his main body. Furthermore, he could not give them to his second doppelganger. Simply put, different individuals could not use the same Esper Ability at the same time.

Therefore, EsGod did not stop collecting Esper Abilities, even those that were repeated, just to create a Super High Risk Esper Ability list.

"When Sisko arrives on Planet Avitan, it will be time for us to take action." Orozen chuckled.

Colin nodded, looked at the second EsGod doppelganger beside him, and said, "Your Excellency EsGod, please wait for a while. We will take action when the time is right."

"Hmm."

The second EsGod doppelganger nodded.

This doppelganger was controlled by the main body, and the main body's consciousness was projected here. Colin and the others were communicating directly with EsGod, who was far away in the Central Galaxy.

This second doppelganger was given many Esper Abilities, such as invisibility, regional teleportation, and shielding from detection.

He had been using his Esper Abilities to hide everyone's traces and used his psychic Esper Ability to shield Sisko's psychic senses that covered the entire mother planet. This was why they were able to hide under Sisko's nose and stay near the mother planet without being discovered.

The main force of stealing the Evolution Cube was this second EsGod doppelganger. Only he could silently send Colin and the others to the storage location of the Evolution Cube.

As for the third doppelganger, he had been lying in ambush on Planet Avitan. His mission was to cooperate with the first doppelganger to stall Sisko.

The abilities of the third doppelganger were all control-type Esper Abilities.

Although the doppelganger had the strength of a Beyond Grade A, it was still a doppelganger and was not Sisko's match. With just one doppelganger, he would not be able to hold on for long. Only with two doppelganger working together would they be able to stall Sisko long enough to prevent him from rushing back to the mother planet.

As for EsGod's confidence in stealing the Evolution Cube, it was because he had the only detailed information about the Evolution Cube.

The Evolution Cube was not a small item.

Without a manual, no one would know how to carry the Evolution Cube around!

When it comes to the middle of the plot, there are more things to consider, and it's hard for me to increase my speed. I'm not like other authors who use an extra update mechanism because I know that I can't keep up. Ever since I hit my head last October, my attention has been easily distracted, and my brain speed has slowed down. I also want to write more, and the faster I write, the better I get. Although I'm not a perfectionist, I don't allow myself to be reckless. I can only try my best to write more on the basis of not deviating from the plot.
